aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:852.title: Sr. Digital Marketing Analyst
aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:852.description: Company Information For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Job Summary The Paid Media team is tasked with establishing company-wide digital media strategies, campaign management, and providing consultative support across multiple AEG divisions such as AEG Presents, Global Touring, Festivals, Goldenvoice, Bowery Presents, Sports, and Global Partnerships. The Sr. Digital Marketing Analyst will be responsible for compiling reporting to evaluate effectiveness and identify optimization opportunities across digital channels, budgets, audiences, creative, while clearly communicating actionable recommendations to drive ticket sales, event awareness, customer acquisition, and brand initiatives based on findings. This role will also work closely with Data & Analytics, Product, and Data Engineering teams for cross-functional projects that supports solutions for paid media data aggregation, mastering, measurement, and visualization. The position will lead projects and work with appropriate teams to ensure tracking for measurement is in place to capture relevant marketing data, develop + maintain attribution models, and define benchmarks against key metrics such as CPA and Return on Ad Spend. Essential Functions Provide analytical support to Paid Media and Marketing teams, compiling performance marketing reports across digital channels using internal BI tools, Google Analytics, native advertising platforms. Communicate results to stakeholders, working with media and strategy teams to demonstrate clear actionable insights for media plans, budget forecasting, targeting/audiences, and creative. Build and maintain comprehensive measurement plans to evaluate paid media performance, calculate benchmarks based on objectives, develop + maintain attribution models to identify trends, testing opportunities, and insights by channel, audience, festival/tour/regional show, and business unit. Partner with Data, Product, Engineering teams to manage data pipelines + ingestion for channel metrics, define data collection requirements and enforce optimal taxonomy for reporting implementations, continual data hygiene + integrity across ad buying and internal platforms. Collaborate with media, marketing, and data teams to inform audience and targeting strategies. Develop tests to evaluate new campaign strategies, ad products, optimization tactics, and targeting features. Manage and lead paid media projects involving data aggregation and measurement tools such as Datorama, Google Analytics / GA4, Tag Manager, DOMO, BigQuery, LiveRamp, server-server integrations with media partners. Ensure appropriate site tracking is in place to capture relevant data points to measure marketing effectiveness. Work closely with data team to develop and maintain reporting dashboards for internal and external use, while providing support for ad hot reporting requests. jobgether-jobgether:lever:1109a947-a176-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Investor Relations Associate based in the United States. This role sits at the intersection of finance, capital markets, communications, and corporate strategy. You will help execute a strategic investor relations program and strengthen relationships with investors and analysts. The position offers exposure to senior leadership, financial results, business strategy, and market dynamics. You will contribute to earnings communications, investor events, conferences, and targeted shareholder engagement. The role also involves analyzing company and peer performance, valuations, and market reactions to key developments. You’ll work cross-functionally with finance, legal, communications, and other business teams on high-priority initiatives. This is an opportunity to build deep expertise in capital markets while helping shape compelling internal and external narratives. Manage day-to-day investor relations activities, including investor events, Analyst Day, marketing materials, the IR website, and relationships with external vendors. Support the full quarterly earnings process, including preparation of earnings scripts, presentations, investor Q&A, and related communications. Help plan and execute conferences, non-deal roadshows, bus tours, and other investor marketing activities. Drive shareholder targeting initiatives to identify and engage potential long-term investors, while measuring the effectiveness of investor engagement. Analyze business fundamentals, company and peer valuations, financial performance, and relevant capital markets data. Monitor investor and analyst reactions to competitive developments, corporate actions, and other market events, translating insights into actionable recommendations for leadership. Build broad knowledge of the business and help develop clear, compelling messaging for both internal stakeholders and the investment community. Ensure investor communications and events are conducted in accordance with Regulation FD requirements. Monitor shareholder concerns and emerging market themes to identify potential issues and improve external communications. Identify and develop innovative ways to use AI and other technologies to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of investor relations activities. Partner with finance, legal, communications, and business leadership on strategic and high-priority initiatives. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, or a related discipline. At least 5 years of experience in investor relations, corporate finance, sell-side research, capital markets, investment banking, or corporate strategy. Strong understanding of finance and accounting, with working knowledge of Regulation FD. Solid capital markets expertise, including the ability to interpret financial statements and develop or understand valuation models commonly used by investors. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to synthesize quantitative data and qualitative insights into clear and compelling narratives. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to both internal stakeholders and external investors. Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively across finance and business functions and establish trust with senior stakeholders. High curiosity and a demonstrated willingness to learn about capital markets, the software industry, competitors, and evolving investor expectations. Proficiency with Excel, PowerPoint, and Google Workspace. Experience in the SaaS or software industry is a plus. Comfort communicating directly with executives and members of the investment community in high-stakes situations is preferred. Familiarity with investor relations platforms such as FactSet or Irwin is advantageous. Benefits: Annual cash compensation range of $114,400–$1

jobgether-jobgether:lever:42603851-dd45-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a MEP Design Engineer based in Switzerland. As an MEP Design Engineer, you’ll contribute to the technical development of a major AI data center project with significant power and infrastructure requirements. You’ll take responsibility for designing and reviewing mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems supporting critical infrastructure. Your work will directly influence reliability, energy efficiency, operational resilience, and regulatory compliance across the facility. You’ll collaborate with technology, IT infrastructure, suppliers, and engineering partners to integrate complex systems into a cohesive design. The role covers everything from electrical distribution and cooling to fire protection, ventilation, and building management systems. You’ll also contribute to technical specifications, tender processes, vendor evaluations, and the ongoing development of the Basis of Design. This is an opportunity to work on advanced infrastructure in a technically demanding, international, and fully remote environment. Develop and review electrical distribution systems , including medium- and low-voltage distribution, UPS systems, diesel generators, and battery energy storage systems (BESS). Design and review cooling and ventilation systems , including chillers, dry coolers, water towers, and liquid cooling solutions where applicable. Coordinate modular facility architecture and ensure effective integration with mechanical, electrical, and plumbing infrastructure. Develop gas fire suppression, ventilation, and OT/IT integration systems, including BMS and DCIM solutions. Review technical and design documentation provided by suppliers, contractors, and engineering partners, identifying risks, inconsistencies, and potential design gaps. Ensure MEP solutions comply with applicable regulatory, safety, reliability, and energy-efficiency requirements. Prepare, maintain, and update the Basis of Design and associated technical specifications. Participate in tender processes and evaluate technical proposals from vendors supplying generators, UPS systems, chillers, switchgear, and other critical equipment. Coordinate closely with IT Infrastructure teams to align power and cooling requirements with IT deployment needs. Support technical coordination throughout the project lifecycle and contribute to resolving design and integration challenges. Requirements 5+ years of professional experience in MEP design for critical infrastructure or heavy-industry facilities, such as data centers, industrial plants, energy facilities, telecommunications infrastructure, or comparable environments. Demonstrated experience designing cooling and ventilation systems ; strong conventional HVAC experience is sufficient. Solid understanding of mechanical and electrical systems used in critical infrastructure environments. Proficiency with AutoCAD, Revit , and relevant engineering calculation or design software. Ability to review multidisciplinary technical documentation and identify engineering risks, discrepancies, and integration issues. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate technical requirements into practical design solutions. Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with suppliers, engineering partners, IT teams, and other stakeholders. English proficiency sufficient to work effectively with international teams and prepare or review technical project documentation. Experience with Tier III/IV facilities is an advantage. Knowledge of direct liquid cooling (DLC) systems or high-density computing environments is a plus. Familiarity with EU or Polish electrical, building, and fire safety regulations is desirable. Experience working with high-density GPU infrastructure such as NVIDIA GB200/GB300 is beneficial. Polish language skills are an advantage. Experience working on greenfi

partyhat-partyhat:ashbyhq:8242894a-476e-.description: THE MISSION Static user interfaces and uninspired motion design are completely dead to us. We need a "Visual Kineticist" to bring the Partyhat web ecosystem to life. Your job is to inject raw motion, dynamic pacing, and spectacular visual effects into our digital canvas—transforming flat designs into living, high-energy interactive experiences. This is a remote, asset-focused role for a high-availability animator who treats motion as an exact science and knows how to command a viewer's attention within milliseconds. We don't care about a traditional animation degree or a corporate agency resume; we care about the physics, timing, and visual weight of your reel. If you have the drive to master our core layout principles, the speed to match our rapid product updates, and the structural discipline to deliver clean, highly optimized assets that integrate flawlessly with modern UI layers, we will give you the ultimate digital stage to build your legacy. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Kinetic Character & Asset Design: Animate characters, environments, and custom icons, preserving absolute volumetric integrity, weight, and visual energy across every sequence. - VFX Engineering: Conceptualize and execute high-octane visual effects that amplify high-stakes actions, user milestones, and critical interactive touchpoints. - UI Motion Integration: Collaborate directly with Frontend Engineers to embed smooth, reactive micro-animations and seamless transitions into our web layouts, eliminating user friction. - Storyboarding & Pre-Visualization: Translate abstract concepts and product roadmaps into clear storyboards, animatics, and scene compositions to lock down narrative momentum before production. - Asset Optimization: Balance high-fidelity visual flair with strict technical performance, outputting clean web-ready files (such as JSON/Lottie, WebP, or layered image sheets) that load instantly on global networks. - Pipeline Management: Maintain a flawless, perfectly cataloged library of master files, ensuring our design and product teams can access and deploy your motion assets in real time. THE SOFTWARE TOOLKIT You must possess elite, day-to-day deployment speed across the following software suites: - Adobe After Effects (AE): Advanced keyframing, parenting, expression scripting, and heavy visual effects (VFX) composition. - Spine 2D: Elite skeletal animation, mesh deformation, and skeletal weight mapping for efficient, liquid-smooth asset motion. - Adobe Photoshop (PS) & Illustrator (AI): Clean layer preparation, asset asset decoupling, and vector/raster graphic management optimized for motion pipelines. THE REQUIREMENTS - The "Principles Elite": Deep, intuitive mastery of core animation mechanics including Timing, Squash and Stretch, Slow-in/Slow-out, Anticipation, and dynamic color theory. - The "Motion Instinct": A breathtaking professional showreel demonstrating raw kinetic flow, sharp weight distribution, and high-impact visual composition. - Hyper-Availability: This isn't a slow-moving design house. When major features drop or live campaigns pivot, you must be highly responsive and available to execute real-time render modifications and asset updates. - Operational Autonomy: Completely self-motivated and highly structured; you can manage massive timelines, complex layer hierarchies, and fast production turnarounds without letting a single detail slip through the cracks. OPERATIONAL DETAILS - Location: Fully Remote. - Schedule: On-call 7 days a week (Requires high flexibility to align with fast-moving code releases and global launch schedules). - Payment: All compensation is processed in digital assets (USDC/USDT). WHY JOIN US? weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:9ab4914a-ad0.description: About Adapt Adapt, a Welo Global brand, is an international digital performance marketing agency focused on driving the success of digital content across platforms and markets. We offer our customers a unique combination of global services designed to support their growth from strategy all the way through to execution, production, and performance measurement. With a collaborative and inclusive environment, you will join a unique culture which celebrates difference and embraces diversity. You will play a key role in developing strong relationships and shared ethos, whilst at the same time benefiting from a wide range of career opportunities, training, and flexibility for work-life balance. Our culture is built on curiosity, and we are looking for team members who have a passion for learning about the developments in the industry, their clients, and their peers. In return, we offer the opportunity to develop your ability and exposure to a wide range of clients from growth-minded startups all the way up to global enterprise clients. Our client base is predominantly focused on B2B businesses, though we do also support customers in the e-commerce and retail space. Regardless of vertical, Adapt offers dynamic and diverse challenges that foster creativity, innovation and application of knowledge to create client solutions. Job Description As a Senior Paid Media Specialist, you will plan and execute client media buying across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Facebook Ads Manager, LinkedIn Ads, and more. Building their technical experience across all major paid media platforms, a Paid Media Specialist will carry out implementation, reporting, and measurement tasks. Paid Media Specialist are responsible for building, optimizing, and reporting on campaign activity for our customers, ensuring that campaigns deliver against objectives. You’ll work within one of our paid media buying teams, running campaigns across multiple platforms, in multiple markets, and potentially in multiple languages, delivering great performance for our clients and helping to maintain and develop Adapt's reputation as a high-quality, transparent, and effective digital media buying agency which is pleasurable and profitable to do business with. We believe in supporting professional development through our career framework, helping you develop your career as a digital marketer from day one.
